So, the mistake happened when the Planner assumed Siegfried's father was the grandfather without verifying. The step where this mistake occurred was when the Planner identified Siegfried's father without proper sources, so the first mistake was made by the Planner at step 3.

But upon reviewing, it seems the WebSurfer didn't fully trace Siegfried's lineage, so the actual error was in the Planner's step to link Siegfried's father without sufficient confirmation, leading to the wrong conclusion.
